projection: whole-world plain equirectangular, lon -180..180 (u=0 at 180W), lat 90..-90 (v=0 at north pole); same convention as three-globe textures
base: NASA Blue Marble (three-globe example/img/earth-blue-marble.jpg, 4096x2048) Lanczos-upsampled x2
seam_hiding: 36-px (~1.6 deg) smoothstep alpha ramp inside the inserted area, 5-deg taper on the far-east (58E) edge
progressive softening of the inserted imagery toward its edge to match upsampled Blue Marble sharpness
low-frequency (mosaic - Blue Marble) land colour difference bled outward with ~3 deg exponential fade
east of 58E: Blue Marble spring-snow veil attenuated and land colour pulled toward the edge colour, fading over 20 deg (so the snow line sits near/after the Urals)
unchanged_outside: lon -30..90, lat 30..85 processing window; everything else is untouched Blue Marble
attribution: Earth imagery: NASA Blue Marble (via three-globe). Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2023-2025.
